title: Skipper: Building Airbnb’s embedded workflow engine
summary: Survives workflow crashes without an orchestrator by embedding Skipper, replaying over checkpoints in the service DB.

title: From Static Rate Limiting to Adaptive Traffic Management in Airbnb’s Key-Value Store
summary: Replaces static QPS quotas, blind to request cost, with load shedding and request units priced by bytes and latency.

title: Building a Next-Generation Key-Value Store at Airbnb
summary: Moves Mussel off hotspot-prone hash sharding to range-sharded NewSQL, seeding presplit tables from backups and Kafka.

title: Seamless Istio Upgrades at Scale
summary: Stops Istio upgrades from waiting on team deploys by having Krispr inject the revision label at CI and pod admission.

title: Achieving High Availability with distributed database on Kubernetes at Airbnb
summary: Keeps quorum through node replacements by handing pod evictions to the DB's Kubernetes operator across per-AZ clusters.

title: Embedding-Based Retrieval for Airbnb Search
summary: Trims huge candidate sets for broad searches with two-tower embeddings, served by IVF as frequent updates bloated HNSW.

title: Transforming Location Retrieval at Airbnb: A Journey from Heuristics to Reinforcement Learning
summary: Replaces fixed map-area heuristics blind to group size with a model that predicts the area and widens it when unsure.

title: Riverbed: Optimizing data access at Airbnb’s scale
summary: Speeds slow cross-service reads with Riverbed views, rebuilt from source on each CDC event so order does not matter.

title: Improving Performance with HTTP Streaming
summary: Cuts asset and data-fetch waterfalls in SSR by flushing the head early and streaming fetched data as a final chunk.

title: Improving Istio Propagation Delay
summary: Traces rising Istio push delay to a read-locking LRU xDS cache and reflection deep copies in debounce, then cuts both.

title: Mussel — Airbnb’s Key-Value Store for Derived Data
summary: Replaces Nebula's DynamoDB and HFile stores, slow to merge, with Mussel's leaderless HRegion replicas fed from Kafka.

title: Upgrading Data Warehouse Infrastructure at Airbnb
summary: Ends per-job shuffle tuning and separate hourly and daily Hive tables with Spark AQE ingestion into one Iceberg table.

title: How Airbnb standardized metric computation at scale
summary: Stops metric drift and data downtime by hashing Minerva configs into data versions whose backfills batch in staging.

title: Himeji: A Scalable Centralized System for Authorization at Airbnb
summary: Ends duplicated permission checks that fan out on reads with Himeji, a Zanzibar-style tuple store written on mutation.

title: Building Airbnb’s Internationalization Platform
summary: Keeps translate calls fast through server outages by serving them from an on-disk store per node, synced by an agent.

title: Avoiding double payments in a distributed payments system
summary: Prevents duplicate payments on retries with Orpheus, an idempotency library that keeps RPCs out of its DB transactions.

title: Building Services at Airbnb, Part 3
summary: Curbs cascading overload and retry storms with a built-in CoDel queue whose back pressure errors clients never retry.

title: Operationalizing Node.js for Server Side Rendering
summary: Traces SSR deploy timeouts to renders interleaving in one Node process, then has HAProxy queue requests one per worker.

title: Building Services at Airbnb, Part 2
summary: Fixes alert gaps and ad hoc metrics with uniform metrics and per-method alerts generated from Thrift IDL annotations.

title: Listing Embeddings in Search Ranking
summary: Captures style that listing metadata misses with click-session embeddings, using bookings as global context.

title: Building Services at Airbnb, Part 1
summary: Replaces untyped JSON APIs and hand-written clients with Thrift IDL codegen inside Dropwizard, keeping the HTTP stack.

title: Nebula as a Storage Platform to Build Airbnb’s Search Backends
summary: Moves search data that outgrew a single machine to Nebula, which merges DynamoDB deltas with HFile snapshots on read.
